changelog:
- Initial release of the "find-skills" skill.
- Helps users discover and install agent skills based on their queries (e.g., "how do I do X?").
- Provides guidance on using the Skills CLI (`npx skills`) for searching and installing skills.
- Includes examples, tips for effective searches, and common categories to assist users.
- Offers instructions for situations when no suitable skills are found.
summary: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express...
